title: Implement Array.prototype.some() and every() From Scratch
description: Write your own implementation of Array.prototype.some() and Array.prototype.every(), matching the real methods' short-circuiting behavior and edge cases (sparse arrays, thisArg support).

title: Implement Array.prototype.includes() Handling NaN Correctly
description: Write your own implementation of Array.prototype.includes(), correctly handling the real method's SameValueZero comparison — including the case that trips up a naive === based implementation: finding NaN in an array.

title: Design a Simple In-Memory Key-Value Store With TTL Expiry (Mini-Redis)
description: Design and implement a small in-memory key-value store supporting get/set/delete plus a per-key TTL (time to live) after which a key automatically expires, without leaking memory for expired entries.

title: Implement a Circuit Breaker for Flaky API Calls
description: Implement a circuit breaker wrapper around an async function that calls a flaky API — after enough consecutive failures it should 'open' and fail fast without calling the underlying function, then attempt to 'half-open' and recover after a cooldown.

title: Build a Minimal State Machine Runner (States, Transitions, Guards)
description: Design and implement a small finite-state-machine runner: given a configuration of states, events, and transitions (with optional guard functions), drive an object through valid state changes and reject invalid ones.

title: Build a Simple Client-Side Router That Matches Path Patterns
description: Implement a minimal client-side router that registers path patterns (including dynamic segments like /users/:id) against handler functions, and matches a given URL to the correct handler with its parsed parameters.

title: Implement a Virtualized List That Renders Only Visible Rows
description: You have a list of 100,000 rows to render. Implement list virtualization: only the rows currently visible in the scroll viewport (plus a small buffer) should exist in the DOM at any time.

title: Build a Minimal createStore() (Redux-Lite: dispatch, subscribe, reducers)
description: Implement a minimal state-management store from scratch: createStore(reducer) returning getState, dispatch, and subscribe, with the same core contract as Redux's own createStore.

title: Implement a Minimal useState Hook Using Closures (How React's State Actually Persists Between Renders)
description: Implement a simplified version of React's useState — a closure-based hook that persists state across repeated 'render' function calls and triggers a re-render when the state setter is called.

title: Implement a Debounced Search Input With Race-Condition-Safe Request Cancellation
description: Wire up a search input that debounces keystrokes before firing a fetch request, and correctly cancels or ignores any in-flight request that a newer keystroke has superseded — so a slow earlier response can never overwrite a faster later one.

title: Build an Undo/Redo Command Stack for a Text Editor
description: Implement an undo/redo system for a simple text editor: every edit is recorded as a command that can be undone and redone, with correct behavior when a new edit happens after an undo (the redo stack should be discarded).

title: Build a Toast/Notification Queue That Shows One at a Time With Auto-Dismiss
description: Implement a toast notification queue: multiple toasts can be enqueued at once, but only one shows at a time, each auto-dismissing after a delay before the next one appears.

title: Implement a Memoized Selector That Only Recomputes When Its Specific Inputs Change (Reselect-Style)
description: Implement a createSelector-style memoized selector: given one or more input selectors and a combiner function, the combiner should only re-run when the specific values returned by the input selectors actually change, not on every call.

title: Build a Deterministic Feature-Flag Bucketing Function (Consistent Hash-Based A/B Assignment)
description: Implement a function that deterministically assigns a given user ID to an experiment bucket (e.g. 'control' or 'variant') based on a target rollout percentage — the same user ID must always land in the same bucket.

title: Implement a Drag-and-Drop List Reordering Utility Without a Library
description: Implement drag-and-drop reordering for a list of items using only native pointer/drag events — no external library — correctly computing the new order as the user drags an item to a new position.

title: Build a Form Validation Utility Supporting Field-Level and Cross-Field Rules
description: Implement a small form-validation utility: each field has its own validation rules, plus some rules depend on more than one field (e.g. 'confirm password must match password'), producing a map of field-level error messages.

title: Implement a Theme Toggle That Persists Choice and Respects prefers-color-scheme
description: Implement a light/dark theme toggle: it should default to the user's OS-level color-scheme preference, let the user explicitly override it, and remember that explicit choice across page reloads.

title: Implement Your Own Array.prototype.reduceRight()
description: Write your own implementation of Array.prototype.reduceRight(), matching the real method's right-to-left iteration order and its behavior when no initial value is provided.
